caption: Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis)
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance, measured as accuracy across 11 datasets, for five different training methods, as described in the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision." The vertical axis (y-axis) is labeled "Average Performance" and ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 10, with dashed horizontal gridlines marking each interval. The horizontal axis (x-axis) lists the training methods in the following order: "Standard," "Self-RAG," "FactTune," "CInGS (w/)," and "CInGS." Each method is represented by a single colored bar: "Standard" is orange, "Self-RAG" is olive green, "FactTune" is light green, "CInGS (w/)" is blue-gray, and "CInGS" is dark blue. The heights of the bars indicate their respective average accuracies: "Standard" is approximately 52, "Self-RAG" is around 54, "FactTune" is about 51, "CInGS (w/)" is roughly 53, and "CInGS" reaches approximately 56. The bars are arranged left to right in the order listed, with no explicit sorting by performance. The tallest bar corresponds to "CInGS," and the shortest to "FactTune," though all bars are relatively close in height, indicating similar overall performance across methods. There are no annotations, error bars, or additional visual emphasis on any particular bar.
